text.tspan: Public pages only: no visitor accounts,
no tracking cookies, no cookie banner.
S3-compatible, the site owner's own account,
watermarked proofs, and one ZIP per delivery gallery
The site owner's own database — private gallery
through the app's admin route — ADR-0014 §4
with an owner-run CLI — not a browser (planned)
no private byte through a Function (planned)
